$comment: Derived from the clone's src/App.jsx mount order and src/components/*, cross-checked against CLONE_SPEC.md §1 (Playwright recon of the live site). The live site has a single route; nav links are in-page anchors and every footer link is external.

meta.source: https://www.flshfrm.com/ (local React + Vite clone in this folder)

categories.SHELL: Page chrome and overlays that are not part of the scrolling story: intro loader, navigation, menus, scroller UI, popup, toasts, footer.
categories.STORY: Explanatory narrative sections introducing what the product is and why it exists.
categories.INTEGRATION: How-to and connectivity sections: integration steps, screencast, supported messengers.
categories.VALUE: Benefit and problem/solution sections aimed at developers and site owners.

shell.intro-loader.description: Full-screen intro: a grid of brand-word items that slides in by column, splits by line, then zooms through the centre word (~6s) before the page reveals.
shell.intro-loader.scope: Shown once per load on the 1 route, before any other section animates.

shell.app-loader.description: Small fixed circular spinner shown while a form submission is pending.
shell.app-loader.scope: Available on the 1 route; visible only during a form submit.

shell.navbar.description: Glass top bar with difference blend: brand mark, anchor links (#why #integration #benefits #roadmap #faq) and a 'Join the beta' action; hides on scroll down, reveals near the top.
shell.navbar.scope: Present on the 1 route at all widths; links collapse into the burger at ≤1060px.

shell.mobile-menu.description: Burger button plus small dropdown panel listing the same anchor links as the navbar.
shell.mobile-menu.scope: Rendered on the 1 route only at ≤1060px.

shell.scrollbar.description: Custom draggable scrollbar thumb driven by the custom smooth scroller.
shell.scrollbar.scope: Desktop only (>1060px) on the 1 route; native scrolling below that.

shell.beta-popup.description: Modal 'Join the beta' form (name + email) with backdrop and close button; opened from the navbar and CTA buttons.
shell.beta-popup.scope: Overlay on the 1 route, opened on demand.

shell.toasts.description: Stacked success/error notifications with a 5s progress bar and close button.
shell.toasts.scope: Overlay on the 1 route, shown after a form submit.

shell.footer.description: Footer with physics-driven draggable letters spelling 'STAY IN TOUCH', contact links, an email signup form and legal links (all external).

hero.home.description: Pinned hero (200vh): split-text headline with italic accent words, intro paragraph, 'Try now' button, spinning globe icon and a WebGL flower.

story.meaning.description: 'What does it mean Flashform?' heading and paragraph beside a looping video (1.mp4, lighten blend).

story.purpose.description: Green rounded scaling panel 'Purpose of using Flashform': problem/solution text that scrolls inside a pinned card, plus 6 messenger icons.

story.why.description: #why — 'Designed to make life {easier}' heading and paragraph beside a looping video (2.mp4).
story.why.scope: Appears once, on the 1 route; target of the #why nav anchor.

integration.steps.description: #integration — giant horizontally scrolling headline with per-letter rise, four numbered steps, then the screencast video that scales in and dissolves to black via a WebGL noise shader.
integration.steps.scope: Appears once, on the 1 route; target of the #integration nav anchor.

integration.messengers.description: 'Integration of your form with different {messengers}' heading with a large arrow and a 'Get a beta' button.

value.benefits.description: #benefits — tilted 'A few important benefits' ticker marquee that flips direction with scroll, plus 6 offset green cards that scale in.
value.benefits.scope: Appears once, on the 1 route; target of the #benefits nav anchor.

value.relief.description: Two-column block on how the product helps developers and site owners ('For developers' / 'For Site owners').

value.problems.description: Second green rounded scaling panel 'Problems that we solve' listing 3 items.

roadmap.timeline.description: #roadmap — large date mark and a horizontally scrolling drawn curve with 3 milestones that reveal as the curve passes them.
roadmap.timeline.scope: On the 1 route at >1060px only (display:none at ≤1060px); target of the #roadmap nav anchor.

support.faq.description: #faq — 'FAQ' heading and a 4-item accordion; items open independently with a rotating arrow.
support.faq.scope: Appears once, on the 1 route; target of the #faq nav anchor.
